correctness.rationale: PASS: The three displayed quadrics make a degree-eight (Z/2)^3 Kummer cover of P¹ via t=x3/x4 with radicands -(1+t²),1-t²,-t and six distinct simple branch points. Ramification gives genus five, and the canonical complete intersection is smooth. Three character quotients have genus zero; the other four are E12:y²=t^4-1, E13:y²=t³+t, E23:y²=t³-t and H:y²=t-t^5. The 2-primary group-ring idempotents split the Jacobian up to 2-power isogeny, preserving its 3-divisible group. Exact quotient point counts at q=3,9 (three elliptics 4,16; H 4,6) yield three factors 1+3T² and H factor 1-2T²+9T^4 by functional equations, proving zeta for all extensions. H Cartier–Manin matrix [[0,-1],[1,0]] is invertible, giving ordinary surface and a-number 0; supersingular elliptic factors contribute three a=1; quartic u^4-2u²+9 is Q-irreducible, giving F3-simplicity. Independently implemented finite F3/F9 quadratic-square counting: original curve 4/24, quotient table (4,4,4,4)/(16,16,16,6), matching claims; the source verifier also contains finite q=27,81 tests but their output was read, not run here. Infinite zeta follows from the quotient-isogeny proof, not finite extrapolation.
